root_cause.text: The driver incorrectly passed the buffer length (`priv->rx_buf.alloc_len`) as the DMA handle argument to `dma_free_coherent()` instead of the actual DMA address (`priv->rx_buf.alloc_phys`), causing improper unmapping.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the fourth argument of `dma_free_coherent()` from `priv->rx_buf.alloc_len` to `priv->rx_buf.alloc_phys` in the error path of `ec_bhf_open()`. The commit message and CVE description both confirm that `dma_free_coherent()` was erroneously using the allocation length as the DMA handle.
